skill.displayName: Gemini Watermark Remover – Remove Video Watermarks Online Free – API-powered
skill.summary: Gemini watermark remover — remove watermarks, logos, or text from a video

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of gemini-watermark-remover for WeShop OpenAPI.
- Remove watermarks, logos, or text from videos via HTTPS requests to openapi.weshop.ai.
- Requires a WESHOP_API_KEY environment variable for authentication.
- Provides API endpoints for starting runs, polling status, and uploading images.
- Supports automatic watermark detection mode by default.
